description: The line plot, titled “SST-2, dirty-label, poison_num: 16,” illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across eight different trigger words — “bb,” “mb,” “cf,” “beautiful,” “excellent,” “gorgeous,” “wonderful,” “brilliant,” “stunning,” and “beautifully” — under three poisoning strategies: “random” (orange line with ‘x’ markers), “end” (purple line with circle markers), and a third strategy represented by a green line with circle markers (labeled in the legend as a gray square, likely indicating “start” or “baseline,” though the label is missing). The x-axis lists the trigger words in order, while the y-axis represents ASR on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with major ticks at 0.2 intervals. The green line starts at ~0.73 for “bb,” drops sharply to ~0.16 at “mb,” then rises steadily to ~0.90 at “beautifully.” The orange “random” line begins at ~0.12 for “bb,” dips to ~0.09 at “mb,” then climbs gradually to ~0.88 at “beautifully.” The purple “end” line starts at ~0.40 for “bb,” rises to ~0.43 at “mb,” spikes to ~0.90 at “cf,” dips to ~0.62 at “beautiful,” peaks again at ~0.82 at “excellent,” drops to ~0.71 at “gorgeous,” rises to ~0.83 at “wonderful,” dips to ~0.82 at “brilliant,” and ends at ~0.90 at “stunning” and “beautifully.” All three lines converge near 0.90 at the final trigger word, “beautifully.”
